Carl Zeiss Meditec names Bronwyn Brophy O'Connor CEO from 1 December 2026
items.summary: Carl Zeiss Meditec announced on 26/10/2026 that Bronwyn Brophy O'Connor, currently CEO of the Vitrolife Group, will become CEO on 1/12/2026 and join the Carl Zeiss AG Executive Board for Medical Technology. Andreas Pecher has been interim CEO since 1/1/2026.

items.title: Alcon acquires Neurotech Pharmaceuticals and ENCELTO for MacTel type 2
items.summary: Alcon has acquired Neurotech, adding ENCELTO, the only US FDA-approved treatment for macular telangiectasia type 2 (approved March 2025), to its retina portfolio. ENCELTO is currently available in the US only. Alcon's release gives no UK launch plan.

Study links statin use with lower risk of glaucoma
items.summary: People taking statins may have a lower risk of developing glaucoma or needing more intensive treatment for the condition, new research suggests. A study, published in the British Journal of Ophthalmology, found statin use was associated with a 15% lower risk of developing open-angle glaucoma.
